name: Mihir Gediya
tagline: I design backends that stay boring under pressure.
summary: Backend engineer with 3+ years shipping distributed services in Java and Python. Strong on API design, event-driven systems with Kafka, data modeling in PostgreSQL, and operating services on AWS and Kubernetes.

bullets: Owned Java/Python services on AWS backing spend-management features.
Designed Kafka event flows for golden-record workflows across tenants.
Tuned Postgres and Redis hotspots cutting p95 latency on core endpoints.
Built Java microservices for RAN telemetry pipelines on Kubernetes.
Shipped observability improvements that cut on-call noise meaningfully.
Collaborated across 3 timezones on release cuts and incident reviews.
Spring Boot + GraphQL services for an automotive data platform.
Built an AWS-backed ingestion pipeline handling millions of vehicle events.
Owned the GraphQL schema and migrations across teams.
Built Python processing pipelines for satellite imagery datasets.
Automated validation checks that previously ran by hand.

education.detail: CGPA 3.92/4.3. Focus on distributed systems, databases, and systems design.
First Class with Distinction (CPI 8.87/10). Capstone on GPI.
